steps.title: Uptime
steps.rule: Go to 8m south-west of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 5m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 5m north-west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 8m south-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Go to 5m west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 5m east of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 8m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: Tanks split for hardcore
steps.rule: Go to 8m south-west of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 8m north-west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 8m north-east of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 8m south-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Go to 5m south-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 5m south-east of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 8m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: Wait near markers clear of pulses and stomp
steps.rule: Read the strat's WaitNearMarkersClearOfPulsesAndStomp: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: PulpingPulses).

steps.title: After curse of the Bombpyre on you
steps.cue: Curse of the Bombpyre on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

RegenHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 12m south-west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 12m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 12m north-west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark 2, 12m north-east of the centre.

steps.title: After blast Beat hits you
steps.rule: Depends on HalfMoon: LeftFirst → E 5m; RightFirst → W 5m.

steps.title: After half Moon resolves
steps.rule: Depends on HalfMoon: LeftFirst → W 5m; RightFirst → E 5m.

steps.title: After half Moon resolves
steps.rule: Go to 2m north of the centre.
